close_reason: Migrated 13 UTCDateTime/UTCDate fields in jmap-tasks-types from String to UTCDate: task.rs CheckItem.updated, Comment.{created,updated}, Task.{utc_start,utc_due,created,updated,progress_updated}, TaskFilterCondition.{after,before}; notification.rs TaskNotification.created, TaskNotificationFilterCondition.{after,before}. Wire format unchanged. 3 .as_deref() test sites in types_test.rs updated to .as_ref().map(AsRef::as_ref). Downstream jmap-tasks-server (which uses .into_inner() on the Option<UTCDate>) and jmap-tasks-client compile and tests pass. cargo clippy -D warnings clean.
description:
Audit follow-up from JMAP-g7wu.9.5. Migrate 13 public String fields documented as UTCDate/UTCDateTime to jmap_types::UTCDate.

Sites (all in crate-jmap-tasks-types/src/):

task.rs:
1. line 86  — CheckItem::updated: Option<String>  (UTCDateTime)
2. line 128 — Comment::created: Option<String>  (UTCDateTime)
3. line 132 — Comment::updated: Option<String>  (UTCDateTime)
4. line 195 — Task::utc_start: Option<String>  (UTCDate-shaped per field name)
5. line 199 — Task::utc_due: Option<String>  (UTCDate-shaped per field name)
6. line 254 — Task::created: Option<String>  (UTCDateTime per RFC 8984 §4.1.5)
7. line 258 — Task::updated: Option<String>  (UTCDateTime per RFC 8984 §4.1.6)
8. line 417 — Task::progress_updated: Option<String>  (UTCDateTime per RFC 8984 §5.2.6)
9. line 500 — TaskFilterCondition::after: Option<String>  (UTCDate)
10. line 504 — TaskFilterCondition::before: Option<String>  (UTCDate)

notification.rs:
11. line 54  — TaskNotification::created: String  (UTCDate)
12. line 127 — TaskNotificationFilterCondition::after: Option<String>  (UTCDate)
13. line 131 — TaskNotificationFilterCondition::before: Option<String>  (UTCDate)

Change:
  Option<String> -> Option<UTCDate>
  String         -> UTCDate

Coordination with JMAP-g7wu.9.3 (already-closed): that bead migrated TasksBackend::compute_task_utc_times to return UTCDate. With this bead Task::utc_start/utc_due (the fields the backend computes into) become Option<UTCDate>, removing one .map(UTCDate::from) round-trip in tasks-server/src/task.rs:48-52.

Out of scope:
- LocalDateTime fields (Task::start, Task::due, Task::recurrence_id — all LocalDateTime per their doc comments).
- ISO 8601 Duration strings (Task::estimated_duration, TasksRecurrencesAccountCapability::max_expanded_query_duration).
- IANA tz identifier strings (Task::time_zone, Task::recurrence_id_time_zone, TaskList::time_zone).
- LocalDate fields (TasksAccountCapability::min_date_time/max_date_time per draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-XX §1.6.1 lines 273-275).
- Person::sent_by (email addr-spec, not date).

API break — 0.2.0 class. Coordinate with sibling beads (calendars-types, contacts-types, filenode-types) per workspace cookie-cutter rule. Canonical extension-types crate is jmap-mail-types (already fully migrated).

Test approach: update any RFC-example fixture tests to construct UTCDate via UTCDate::new_validated() or UTCDate::from() — wire JSON unchanged because UTCDate is a transparent newtype around String.

Acceptance:
- cargo test -p jmap-tasks-types passes.
- cargo clippy -p jmap-tasks-types -- -D warnings clean.
- All 13 fields use Option<UTCDate> or UTCDate.
- Downstream jmap-tasks-server compiles after refactoring the .map(UTCDate::from) chain at tasks-server/src/task.rs:48-52.
- RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-tasks-types --no-deps clean.
title: UTCDate migration in jmap-tasks-types (JSCalendar UTCDateTime fields, filter bounds, notifications)
